description: A professional dermatologist-inspired nighttime skincare routine designed to target and manage oily skin, focusing on deep cleansing, hydrating, and balancing the skin overnight.
frequency: Once per day, recommended before bed.

night_steps.action: Cleansing with a gentle yet effective cleanser
night_steps.purpose: Remove excess oil and impurities without stripping the skin of its natural oils.

night_steps.action: Toning to balance the pH level and tighten pores
night_steps.purpose: Helps in reducing excess oil production and refines skin texture.
Prevents skin from overcompensating and producing more oil to compensate for the lack of moisture.

night_steps.action: Using a targeted serum with antioxidants
night_steps.purpose: Protects against environmental stressors and promotes skin cell turnover, reducing the appearance of pores and fine lines.

night_steps.action: Applying a non-greasy, oil-free night cream or balm
night_steps.purpose: Provides deep hydration for the skin while you sleep and helps in repairing the skin barrier.

weekly_steps.action: Exfoliating with a chemical or physical exfoliant

dont: Avoid using heavy, greasy products that can clog pores and exacerbate oiliness.
Do not wash your face excessively as this can irritate the skin and worsen acne.
common_mistakes: Over-exfoliating which can lead to dryness and irritation.
Using too many heavy moisturizers at night, leading to excess oil production.

expected_results.2_weeks: Reduction in oiliness, clearer and smoother skin texture.
expected_results.1_month: Enhanced skin hydration and a reduction in the appearance of pores.
expected_results.3_months: Significant improvement in overall skin health, with reduced breakouts and an even complexion.

expert_tips: Always use products that are oil-free and non-comedogenic to avoid clogging pores.
Stay hydrated both from within (through water intake) and without (by using hydrating skincare products).
